types.explanation: EHLO command from RFC5321 initiates an SMTP session and requests service extensions.
HELO command from RFC5321 initiates an SMTP session using the older greeting form.
MAIL FROM command from RFC5321 begins a mail transaction; the first token is MAIL.
RCPT TO command from RFC5321 specifies a mail recipient; the first token is RCPT.
DATA command from RFC5321 begins the transfer of message content.
RSET command from RFC5321 aborts or resets the current mail transaction.
SEND FROM command from RFC5321 requests delivery to a terminal; the first token is SEND.
SOML FROM command from RFC5321 requests delivery to a terminal or mailbox; the first token is SOML.
SAML FROM command from RFC5321 requests delivery to both a terminal and a mailbox; the first token is SAML.
VRFY command from RFC5321 asks the server to verify an address.
EXPN command from RFC5321 asks the server to expand a mailing list or alias.
HELP command from RFC5321 requests helpful information from the server.
NOOP command from RFC5321 is a no-operation that does not change server state.
QUIT command from RFC5321 closes the SMTP session.
TURN command from RFC5321 reverses the roles of the SMTP client and server.
BDAT command from RFC3030 transmits a binary data chunk as an alternative to DATA.
STARTTLS command from RFC3207 initiates TLS negotiation on the SMTP channel.
AUTH command from RFC4954 initiates SASL authentication.
